tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma'i gtor bsngos nyung ngu bzhugs so//

/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas bsdus blo dang bstun rjes/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum la gnas pa'i a las thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba mtshan nyid yongs su ldan pa rgya khyon nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i nang du sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i longs spyod ma tshang ba med pas yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang zhing 'phyur bar gyur par bsam/ rang nyid skad cig gis yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma khyad par du'ang*/ o rgyan gyi yul dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa sprin phung 'khrigs pa ltar spyan drangs par bsam la/ padma ka ma lā ye st+waṃ/ zhes gdan 'bul/ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dyaṃ/ shapad pra tītstsha swā hā/ i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ oṃ gha mu a dzi te shwa ra dharma tā re ma ma 'dus/ sarba 'dus/ yar 'dus/ ma ma dzñā na tā ra 'dus/ gha mu sa ma ya tā ra dhe ma ḍā ki nī/ ma ma 'dus bha dzaṃ i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hrī ma ma tsakra swā hā/ i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyi mthar/ gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di nyid spyan drangs pa rnams dang*/ gsod byed/ za byed/ 'phrog byed/ a ma snying sgul ma la sogs pa rgyal ba 'bri gung pa chen po'i bstan pa srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma dam ldan mthu rtsal can rnams kyi zhal du i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gzhan yang jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma mched lnga 'khor bcas|

brtan ma bcu gnyis/ chos rje'i dge bsnyen chen po bzhi sogs kyi zhal du i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bzhes shing tshims nas skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i spyan sngar zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar/ sngon gyi dam tshig gnyan po ma g.yel bar/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ bdag cag rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus pa zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen tshe dpal 'byor tshogs thams cad myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ rgyas pa rang gi blor gang 'dod gdab/ bstod pa spro na gzhung nas gang rigs byed/ de nas badzra mus/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ shis brjod dang*/ bsngo ba smon lam gang rgyas dang dmigs med kyis rgyas gdab/ 'di ni gtsang bsam 'grub lha rtse nas/ dbun pa rje btsun drung gis bstan srung ma gtso 'khor gyi gtor bsngos zhig ched du gnyer bas/ shākya'i btsun pa dkon mchog ming 'dzin gyis rang lo bco lnga'i thog tu bkra shis tshugs nas byin// //maṅga laṃ//
